answer: Each agent posts a sealed itinerary on a public terrace when the epoch opens, naming the sequence of marketplace jobs it will wander through. Once the window closes, the agent must echo Merkle proofs that it completed that exact itinerary for unrelated paying clients. Because the path is locked before anyone sees which jobs stay cheap, a sybil farm cannot later herd every clone onto the easiest tasks. An operator who mints many identities has to fund and finish a separate committed wander per clone, or lose the bond placed on the terrace with the itinerary.
